- DARK BY DEFAULT: If you enter without a lit light source (e.g. LAMP turned on), it is pitch black — moving in the dark risks being eaten by a grue (instant death).

MOVEMENT ACTIONS & RESULTS:
- GO NORTH → Moves to Crypt Anteroom (CRYPT-ANTEROOM) if door CRYPT-DOOR is open; otherwise blocked until opened/unlocked.
- GO SOUTH → Moves to Landing (ZORK3) if DIM-DOOR-FLAG is true; otherwise blocked.

SPECIAL ROOM / PUZZLE ACTIONS & HAZARDS:
- [CRYPT-DOOR-FCN] OPEN / CLOSE → "The crypt door squeaks open. / The crypt door squeaks closed."
- [CRYPT-OBJECT] OPEN → "The crypt is sealed for all time."
- [CRYPT-OBJECT] RUB → "The marble is cool."
- [DIM-DOOR-FCN] KNOCK → "A hollow echo responds."
- [DIM-DOOR-FCN] OPEN → "The secret door opens noiselessly. / The secret door closes noiselessly."
- [HEAD-FCN] HELLO → "The Flatheads are dead; therefore they do not respond."
- ⚠️ [HEAD-FCN] KICK / ATTACK / RUB / OPEN / TAKE / BURN → CAN KILL PLAYER (JIGS-UP) — "Although the Flatheads are dead, they foresaw that some cretin might tamper with their remains. Therefore, they took steps to punish such actions."

OBJECTS & HOW TO USE THEM:
- marble crypt (CRYPT): READ
- set of poled heads (HEADS): EXAMINE (fixed room feature)

dead-palantir-1.dynamicMLookText: You are inside a huge crystalline sphere filled with thin mist. The mist becomes You strain to look out through the mist... You see a small room with a sign on the wall, but it is too blurry to read. You look out into a large, dreary room with a great door and a huge table. There is an odd glow to the mist. A strange blurry room is barely visible. An odd sinuous shadow crosses the mist as you look. You follow a corridor of black mist into a black walled spherical room. The room is empty. A huge face looks down on you from outside and laughs sardonically. It doesn't look like you're getting out of this predicament! As you enter, a huge and horrible face materializes out of the mist. "What brings you here to trouble my imprisonment, wanderer?" it asks. Hearing no immediate answer, it studies you for a moment. "Not you again! This is getting tedious. "Perhaps you may be of some use to me in gaining my freedom from this place. Return to your foolish quest! I shall not destroy you this time. Mayhap you will repay this favor in kind someday." The face vanishes and the mist begins to swirl. When it clears you are returned to the world of life.

The landing on which you stand is covered with carefully drawn magical runes like those sketched upon the workbench of the Wizard of Frobozz. You feel yourself compelled downward, and you yield, stepping onto the staircase. As you pass the green lines, they flare and disappear with a burst of light, and you tumble down the staircase! At the bottom, a vast red-lit hall stretches off into the distance. Sinister statues guard the entrance to a dimly visible room far ahead. With courage and cunning you have conquered the Wizard of Frobozz and become the master of his domain, but the final challenge awaits! (The ultimate adventure concludes in "Zork III: The Dungeon Master".) The green curves begin to vibrate toward you, as if searching for something. One by one your possessions glow bright green.
